name: 5 Merino Drive
agent: Ciarán Dunphy, DNG Ella Dunphy, Kilkenny
questions: The 189 m² on Daft includes the 59 m² garage, utility and store building; the floor plan gives the house itself as 130.1 m². Is that right, and how big is the site (our rough read of your aerial is about 0.1 ha / 0.27 ac)?

BuyerIQ says the house sits beside a mapped river flood zone (the King's River runs just north of the village). Has the house, garden or Merino Drive ever flooded, and is buildings insurance in place without a flood exclusion?
What is the central heating fuel and the boiler's age? The listing gives BER D1 (227 kWh/m²/yr) but only mentions the Stanley stove and an electric fire.
Are water and drainage on the public mains, and is the rear boundary next to the field secure enough for two dogs?
What is the 7.34 × 3.36 m store with reduced headroom built from (the roof looks like corrugated or translucent sheeting), and does the garage have power?

ai.why: A turnkey single-storey five-bed at €395k in a walkable village 15 minutes from Kilkenny, with a wet room beside the parents' end. But the house itself is 130 m² (the 189 m² counts the garage), the bedrooms and common rooms are small for six, there are only two bathrooms, and it's on about a quarter-acre in the village with a neighbour close on one side and a flood zone beside it.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house is lived in and turnkey.

water.detail: Likely mains: not stated, but it's a village-centre address in Stoneyford. Confirm with the agent.

sewer.detail: Likely mains sewer: not stated, but it's in the village; confirm the connection on survey.

internet.detail: Full fibre at the address per BuyerIQ ('Fast broadband — 387 Mb full fibre'); the listing doesn't mention broadband. Provider not confirmed; NBI's Thomastown deployment area names Stoneyford.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: All single storey: the east wing has a 3.42 × 3.31 m bedroom and a 3.45 × 3.74 m bedroom off a small hall beside the kitchen, sharing a 3.20 × 2.40 m wet room with dual shower heads (from the floor plan).

bedsNote: All on one level, from about 8.2 m² (2.87 × 2.86 m) to 12.9 m² (3.45 × 3.74 m)
heating: Not stated; radiators, a Stanley wood-burning stove in the sitting room and an electric fire in the living room
tagline: A turnkey, extended five-bed bungalow of 130 m² on a quarter-acre plot in Stoneyford village, with a garage block and a long mature rear garden, 15 minutes from Kilkenny.

pros.detail: About €3,040/m² of house (130 m²), or €2,087/m² on Daft's 189 m²; stamp duty about €3,950.

pros.text: Single storey with a wet room for the parents
pros.detail: No stairs at all; two doubles in the east wing share a 3.20 × 2.40 m wet room with dual shower heads and a towel warmer.

pros.text: Kilkenny about 15 minutes; St Luke's ED close
pros.detail: The listing says 15 minutes to Kilkenny city and 5 to the M9; St Luke's 24-hour ED, which takes children, is about 14 km straight-line.
Stoneyford NS is 540 m, a bus stop (TFI Local Link 891 to Kilkenny) 160 m, and the Londis is on Main Street, a short walk.

pros.text: Turnkey, with a new-looking wet room
pros.detail: Lived-in and well kept: timber floors, a kitchen with a roof lantern, a Stanley stove and a recently fitted wet room.

pros.text: Garage block and mature rear garden
pros.detail: A 4.72 × 5.00 m garage, a 2.17 × 4.80 m utility and a 7.34 × 3.36 m store (59 m² in all), a patio, and a lawned garden backing onto a field.
BuyerIQ shows 387 Mb full fibre at the address.

cons.detail: The floor plan gives 130.1 m² for the house; Daft's 189 m² adds the 59.1 m² garage block. Common rooms are a 4.59 × 4.16 m kitchen, a 7.31 × 2.46 m living room and a 3.42 × 3.53 m sitting room, about 49 m² for six.

cons.text: Village plot of about a quarter-acre
cons.detail: Rough read of the agent's aerial: about 44 × 25 m (≈0.1 ha / 0.27 ac). A house sits about 5–10 m away on the north side, with a car park and a large shed-roofed building across the road; only the east side opens to a field.
A 1.93 × 1.63 m main bathroom for the west-wing bedrooms and the wet room in the east wing; no en suites.
Two of the five are about 2.9 × 2.86 m (8.2–8.3 m²); the largest is 3.45 × 3.74 m. The living room is a long, narrow 2.46 m wide.
BuyerIQ flags 'moderate river (fluvial) flood risk' next to a mapped zone; the King's River runs less than 500 m north of the village. BuyerIQ also shows one locked 'critical' finding.

cons.text: BER D1, heating fuel not stated
cons.detail: 227 kWh/m²/yr. An insulation and heat-pump upgrade is a rough €30–50k before SEAI grants.
Grennan College, Thomastown (DEIS) is about 6 km; Scoil Aireagail, Ballyhale (good progression) is about 6.6 km, and St Kieran's and Kilkenny College are about 12–13 km.
